observations.behavior: Documentation update: P1.F1.H1 adds a bullet explaining that rescheduled emails retain queue priority and that push notification retries while queued preserve the workflow's message category priority.
observations.code_quote: - Rescheduled emails keep their email queue priority while waiting. After a team-cap, workflow-pacing, or SES-throttle retry, the workflow restores its origin queue and priority when it next leaves the email queue. A push notification retried while the workflow is on the email queue behaves the same way and waits at the priority of its own message category.
observations.posthog_connection: This documentation describes a queue-priority preservation behavior for rescheduled and retried messages, which could help users understand how priority is maintained during throttling or retry. No implementation is supplied, so no score.
